data_kind: independent artificial real-valued arrays; no biological inputs
preprocessing: training-only feature mean and population SD; no target scaling
splits: independently generated train/validation/test arrays; fixed within each paired trajectory
selection: fixed epochs only; no early stopping or validation/test selection

scenarios.expected: longer training lowers train MSE but worsens test MSE

primary: paired epoch120 minus epoch12 test MSE, separately per scenario
secondary: train/validation MSE and train/validation/test Spearman; positive rank delta is better
uncertainty: sample SD, SE and nominal 95% paired Student-t interval over 10 independent seeds; no biological inference
directional_contract: expected MSE direction in >=8/10 seeds and paired mean 95% interval excluding zero; overfit also requires negative mean train-MSE delta
replay: bitwise same-environment parameter/optimizer/batch-RNG/checkpoint replay; independent complete rerun
failure_policy: retain all seeds/scenarios; no replacements, scenario tuning, architecture search or outcome-driven reruns
